name: @dsh-external/dsh-campaign-memory
description: Campaign memory for the nine security presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content (credentials stay in their own local vaults, memories carry pointers only), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback RPC surface, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.
author: SeaOf0
